inspections.finding: On viewer page 526 (printed תקט / 509), the complete bet in בּצדק has two vertically stacked round dark nodes below the bet base bar with clear white separation between the upper and lower nodes and below the consonant base, while preserving the interior dagesh. It matches same-page bet sheva in בְּמַיִם and בְּמַאֲסָר, and defeats bet patah in בַּחֹשֶׁךְ, bet qamats in בָּנִים, nun hiriq in נִמְנַע, and he tsere in הֵן. Certify U+05B0 after U+05D1 U+05BC.

On viewer page 526, the complete tsadi in בּצדק sits above a three-node triangular mark (two upper nodes and a third lower central node, with the upper-left and lower node joined diagonally and the upper-right node separate). It matches shin segol in בַּחֹשֶׁךְ and דֶּרֶךְ on the same page, and defeats tsadi sheva in וַיֵּעָצְבוּ, tsadi patah in נֶצַח, he tsere in הֵן, and dalet qamats in עַל־יָדָם. Certify U+05B6 after U+05E6.

On viewer page 526, the complete dalet in בּצדק sits above a three-node triangular mark with open white space between the two upper nodes and a third lower central node. It matches dalet segol in דֶּרֶךְ and shin segol in בַּחֹשֶׁךְ on the same page, and defeats dalet qamats in עַל־יָדָם and יָדֶיךָ, tsadi patah in נֶצַח, he tsere in הֵן, and bet sheva in בְּמַיִם. Certify U+05B6 after U+05D3.
